commits.subject: Update terminology in FedRAMP consolidated rules: rename "Certification Overview Package" to "Certification Package Overview" and adjust references
Add a note on PAIN levels to FRD-PAI (Potential Agency Impact) definition indicating the levels are defined in VER-EVA-EPA (Estimate Potential Agency Impact)
Remove Class A certification maintenance requirements from CPO-CSF-CPM (Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5)
Update notes section in FRC-CLA-MFR to clarify that providers MUST address the Key Security Indicators even if they intend to pursue a Rev 5 Program Certification path in the future.
Add "Certification Path" to terms for FRC-CLA-MFR
Update IA-05 guidance to direct users to the latest NIST Digital Identity Guidelines and remove references to specific instances of SP 800-63
Update metadata version and last_updated field in FedRAMP consolidated rules

summary.headline: 10 changed
glance: This update has **10 changed** (2 substantive, 8 minor, 0 editorial, 0 mapping-only).

`CPO-CSF-CPM` Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5: Class A obligation level removed.

changed.name: Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5
changed.text_before:
Class A: Providers with Rev5 Class A Certifications SHOULD persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.
Class B: Providers with Rev5 Class B Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.
Class C: Providers with Rev5 Class C Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.
Class D: Providers with Rev5 Class D Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every six months.
changed.text_after:
Class B: Providers with Rev5 Class B Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.

fields.label: Class A statement

fedramp_notes: 2026-07-14: Removed reference to class A. All class A certifications are 20x.

changed.name: Mandatory FedRAMP Rules for Class A
changed.text_before: Providers seeking a Class A FedRAMP Certification MUST address all rules in this FedRAMP Class A Certification subset (FRC-CLA) AND the following additional FedRAMP Class A rules; the appropriate artifacts or information mapping for all rules MUST be supplied in the FedRAMP Certification Package.
changed.text_after: Providers seeking a Class A FedRAMP Certification MUST address all rules in this FedRAMP Class A Certification subset (FRC-CLA) AND the following additional FedRAMP Class A rules; the appropriate artifacts or information mapping for all rules MUST be supplied in the FedRAMP Certification Package.

fields.label: Notes
fields.before:
Some of these specific FedRAMP rules may not have similar counterparts in external frameworks and providers will need to implement new processes to follow these rules.
In general, for each of these FedRAMP requirements, providers should include a sufficiently detailed summary that reviewers will not need to dig into the related security framework materials to understand the related decisions - just saying "see SOC 2 report" is not particularly helpful.
Information about how the provider addresses the included Key Security Indicators are required for both Rev5 and 20x Class A Certifications.
fields.after:
Some of these specific FedRAMP rules may not have similar counterparts in external frameworks and providers will need to implement new processes to follow these rules.
In general, for each of these FedRAMP requirements, providers should include a sufficiently detailed summary that reviewers will not need to dig into the related security framework materials to understand the related decisions - just saying "see SOC 2 report" is not particularly helpful.
Information about how the provider addresses the included Key Security Indicators are required to receive a class A certification even if the provider intends to pursue a Rev 5 Program Certification path in the future.

sentences: Notes reworded (7 words removed, 21 words added).
fedramp_notes: 2026-07-14: Clarified that providers MUST address the Key Security Indicators even if they intend to pursue a Rev 5 Program Certification path in the future.

changed.name: FedRAMP Certification Package

changed.text_after: Providers seeking a Certification MUST supply a complete FedRAMP Certification Package to FedRAMP for initial certification; the FedRAMP Certification Package MUST include at least the following information:

fields.label: Required information
fields.before:
A Certification Package Overview
A Security Decision Record
A real or example Ongoing Certification Report following CCM-OCR-AVL (Report Availability)

Information about the Cloud Service Offering following CPO-CSO-OVR (Overview of the Cloud Service Offering)
Implementation, Validation, and Assessment information for each relevant FedRAMP requirement/control/ksi as defined in SDR-CSO-FRR (FedRAMP Rules)
A real or example Ongoing Certification Report following CCM-OCR-AVL (Report Availability)

sentences: Required information reworded (8 words removed, 30 words added).

changed.name: Potential Agency Impact
changed.text_before: The estimated cumulative effect of unauthorized access, disruption, harm, or other adverse impacts to all agencies using the cloud service that are likely to result from security incidents or the exploitation of vulnerabilities in the cloud service offering; as estimated following appropriate FedRAMP rules to calculate the Potential Agency Impact N-rating (PAIN).
changed.text_after: The estimated cumulative effect of unauthorized access, disruption, harm, or other adverse impacts to all agencies using the cloud service that are likely to result from security incidents or the exploitation of vulnerabilities in the cloud service offering; as estimated following appropriate FedRAMP rules to calculate the Potential Agency Impact N-rating (PAIN).

fields.label: Note
fields.after: Potential Agency Impact N-rating (PAIN) levels are defined in VER-EVA-EPA (Estimate Potential Agency Impact)
